name: Brace Pike
desc: Plants ash-shaft into turf, reflecting 12 piercing damage to charging melee foes for 6s.
flavor: Horses and gnolls learn the same lesson at three paces.

name: Shield Wall
desc: Locks oak-and-iron rim, boosting physical armor by 8 and frontal block by 25% for 6s.
flavor: Stand shoulder to shoulder until the arrows stop.

name: Cleaving Arc
desc: Sweeps a heavy blade across a 120-degree front, striking up to three adjacent enemies.
flavor: A broad swing clears room to breathe in tight ditches.

name: Quarry Swing
desc: Hammers downward with pick or maul, ignoring 6 armor and staggering plated targets.
flavor: Every stone has a seam if you strike it hard enough.

name: Breaker's Rush
desc: Charges four tiles into enemy ranks, dealing blunt damage and knocking foes back 2 tiles.
flavor: Weight and momentum break pikes faster than speeches.

name: Lock Shields
desc: Forms a tight defensive cordon, granting nearby allies within 3 tiles +6 armor for 6s.
flavor: Overlap the rims and let their cleavers spark.

name: Hold the Line
desc: Roots the mercenary in place for 7s, granting immunity to knockback and +20% block chance.
flavor: Nobody crosses this plank while I still have boots.

name: Shield Bash
desc: Slams iron boss into target's jaw, stunning for 1.5s and interrupting active spells.
flavor: Cheaper than a ward and twice as convincing.

name: Galvanic Arc
desc: Discharges static lightning that jolts primary target and jumps to two nearby enemies.
flavor: Wet mail conducts copper sparks remarkably well.

name: Execution Sweep
desc: Delivers a ruthless two-handed cleave dealing double damage to foes below 35% health.
flavor: No sense leaving wounded raiders behind your heels.

name: Sunder Hinges
desc: Hooks armor straps and rivets, reducing target physical armor by 6 for 8s.
flavor: Once the pauldron drops, the rest is easy.

name: Aether Ward
desc: Wraps an ally in woven ley-static, absorbing up to 55 incoming damage for 8s.
flavor: Keeps robes intact long enough to finish the third syllable.

name: Living Bastion
desc: Anchors stance for 6s, cutting all incoming physical and elemental damage by 50%.
flavor: A wall of riveted iron that refuses to topple.

name: Unbroken Standard
desc: Rallies nearby mercenaries within 5 tiles, cleansing fear and granting +25% speed for 8s.
flavor: As long as the rag stays upright, nobody runs.

name: Shatter-Flint Head
desc: Fires a packed quartz-shrapnel quarrel that bursts in a 2.5-tile radius, piercing armor.
flavor: Ironcamp sappers pack river flint behind every bodkin.

name: Field Tourniquet
desc: Binds torn arteries with carbolic linen, restoring health and halting active bleed effects.
flavor: Hold still while I cinch it—screaming wastes breath.

name: Caltrop Scatter
desc: Flings forged iron spikes across a 2.5-tile patch, slowing foes by 40% and causing bleed.
flavor: Four-pointed iron works even in pitch-dark marsh fog.

name: Writ of Shackle
desc: Binds target's ankles with astral chains, reducing movement and attack speed by 35% for 5s.
flavor: Signed in cold ink and heavy as a millstone.

name: Fuse Satchel
desc: Hurls a pitch-sealed powder charge that detonates after 1s, shattering shields and barricades.
flavor: Count to three, toss, and keep your visor down.
